headline: Executive order aims to end COVID-19 vaccine requirements for students attending schools.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order is meant to end COVID-19 vaccine mandates in schools and keep education open to students who are not vaccinated. No official summary was provided, so the exact rules, how they will be enforced, and which agencies carry them out are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Students may not be required to get a COVID-19 vaccine to attend school.
Schools that require COVID-19 vaccines for students may face new federal rules or pressure to drop those requirements.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 14, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the title.
